---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
A == x' = (x+1)%3
B == x' = (x+2)%3
Step(i) == x' = (x+i)%3
A1 == \/ x'=2 \/ /\ x'=1 /\ 1 \div 0=0
A2 == \/ x'=1 \/ /\ x'=2 /\ 2 % 0=0
Next == \/ /\ x = 0 /\ x' \in {0}
 \/ /\ x = 1 /\ x' \in {1}
 \/ /\ x = 2 /\ x' \in {2,1}
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x /\ WF_x(Next)
P == WF_x(IF x=1 THEN 1 \div 0 = 0 ELSE x=4)
====
config: SPECIFICATION Spec PROPERTY P CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
A == x' = (x+1)%3
B == x' = (x+2)%3
Step(i) == x' = (x+i)%3
A1 == \/ x'=2 \/ /\ x'=1 /\ 1 \div 0=0
A2 == \/ x'=1 \/ /\ x'=2 /\ 2 % 0=0
Next == \/ /\ x = 0 /\ x' \in {0,1,2}
 \/ /\ x = 1 /\ x' \in {1,2,0}
 \/ /\ x = 2 /\ x' \in {2,0}
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x /\ WF_x(Next)
P == WF_x(IF x=1 THEN 1 \div 0 = 0 ELSE x=4)
====

---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
A == x' = (x+1)%3
B == x' = (x+2)%3
Step(i) == x' = (x+i)%3
A1 == \/ x'=2 \/ /\ x'=1 /\ 1 \div 0=0
A2 == \/ x'=1 \/ /\ x'=2 /\ 2 % 0=0
Next == \/ /\ x = 0 /\ x' \in {0,1,2}
 \/ /\ x = 1 /\ x' \in {1,2,0}
 \/ /\ x = 2 /\ x' \in {2,0,1}
V == x
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x /\ WF_x(Next)
P == WF_x(IF x=1 THEN 1 \div 0 = 0 ELSE x=4)
====
